'''Pascoe'''<ref name="Name">{{SWCT|set=Tales of the Outer Rim - 2025|cardname=Pascoe|nolink=1}}</ref> was a [[Snivvian]] [[pirate]] active during the [[New Republic Era]]. They were originally a member of the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] led by [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the crew [[Silvo's pirate raid|attacked]] a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant bulk freighter]], capturing the [[Bulk freighter|ship]] as its [[merchant]] crew attempted fight off the pirates. Pascoe was with the rest of the crew when they breached the [[Magnetic seal|magnetically sealed]] vault of the freighter. After the vault was opened and the pirates realized that it was empty, they participated in the mutiny against their captain Silvo for leading them to an empty vault.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pascoe first appeared unnamed in the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', played by [[Dawn Dininger]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> They were later identified by a card in the "Tales of the Outer Rim - 2025" set on [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]].<ref name="Name" />
